After the successful capture of [nation]Orphogron[/nation]ian uranium, the high command debated what to do with it. The suggestion of constructing nuclear weapons came up mutiple times, however, it was deemed to expensive. Then, the supreme leader suggested something nobody had expected. In the recent months, large amounts of non-muslim resistance have cropped up around various towns in Sal-Baliz territory. So far, nothing had been done about it, because the supreme leader feared that doing so too obviously would bring the might of THEP crashing down on them even harder than before, but now a perfect opportunity had arisen. Poison the water supply. Soon, tonnes of uranium was being pumped into water around the Sal-Baliz. Within a few days, entire towns were dead. As the Sal-Baliz usually do with abandoned towns, it has been handed over to SummitONE to construct yet another weapons manufacturing powerhouse.
